to: a broadcast observer: a socket that connected with `broadcast=1`, without `no_graphics=1` and without a matched `secret`. The server must be `normal` and not PvP (node/logic/observer_broadcast.js:3-6)

fields.name: group
fields.description: The group that the camera shows: `"party:<leader>"`, `"solo:<name>"`, `"town:<map>"`, or `null` when there is no group.

fields.name: party
fields.description: The members of the group, up to 10, keyed by name. It is `{}` for a town group or no group.

fields.name: focus
fields.description: The members in the camera frame. Each is in the instance of the anchor character, 230 px or less in `x` and 125 px or less in `y` from it.

fields.name: map
fields.description: The map of the camera: the map of the anchor character, or the town map.

fields.name: x
fields.description: The camera position: the center of the `focus` characters, or the town point when `focus` is empty.

fields.name: online
fields.description: The characters online on this server, without NPCs and disconnected characters.

fields.name: remaining_ms
fields.description: The time until the camera can change group. The group changes at each 30 s boundary of the server clock.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: `"group"`: the camera follows a character. `"town"`: the town square shot. `"waiting"`: there is nothing to show.

fields.name: available
fields.description: `false` only when `kind` is `"waiting"`. Then the camera does not move.

fields.name: town_players
fields.description: The living characters in the town square shot. The town shot needs 6 or more.

confirm.note: `remaining_ms` comes from `performance.now()`, so it usually has a fraction. `x`/`y` is the center of the box around the `focus` characters.

senders.what: The `loaded` handler, once, when the socket becomes a broadcast observer.
`broadcast_observer_loop`, every 250 ms, for each broadcast observer.
